item.text: The existing status copy is currently built inside `CurrentDeviceSection`, and `DeviceDetails` takes the broader SDK device type without a status card. I’m checking the local device type and rendering tests now so the shared component fits the current conventions and ordering.

The shared card now owns both localized status variants. `CurrentDeviceSection` renders it after the tile (and after expanded details), while `DeviceDetails` places it directly below the session heading. I adjusted the existing details fixture to satisfy its new `DeviceWithVerification` type; next I’m running the focused tests and refreshing their snapshots for the intended UI change.
